notes: Product keeps no store: the catalogue is fetched, never persisted, so ProductClient is the whole of its data layer.
SearchHistory keeps no DTO: it is stored locally and never crosses a wire, so there is no payload shape to map away from.
Session keeps its stores under Data/Auth and Data/Session rather than at the top of Data. It has eight files there where its neighbours have two to four, and grouping them is what that size asks for.
